```python
import dlt
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, trim
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
target_schema = spark.conf.get("target_schema")  # silver target schema, e.g., distributor_silver
# Derive bronze schema from silver target
bronze_schema = target_schema.replace("_silver", "_bronze")
bronze_table = f"{catalog}.{bronze_schema}.distributor_mv"

@dlt.expect_or_drop("valid_distributor_id", "distributor_id IS NOT NULL")
@dlt.table(
    name="distributor_mv",
    comment="Silver distributor view with cleaned data",
    table_properties={"quality": "silver"},
    schema="""
        distributor_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        distributor_name STRING,
        phone_number STRING,
        street_address STRING,
        postal_code STRING,
        city STRING,
        state STRING,
        country STRING
    """
)
def distributor_mv():
    # Read from bronze table as a batch source
    df = spark.read.table(bronze_table)
    # Trim whitespace from string columns
    string_cols = ["distributor_name", "phone_number", "street_address", "postal_code", "city", "state", "country"]
    for c in string_cols:
        df = df.withColumn(c, trim(col(c)))
    return df
```

```python
    target="distributor_cdc_stream",
    source=dlt.read("raw_distributor"),
    keys=["distributor_id"],
    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
```
